description_en: Queries the details of a specified ACK cluster connector
description_zh: 查询指定ACK集群连接器详情
name: DescribeAckClusterConnector

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the ACK cluster connector. You can obtain the value from:
[DescribeAckClusterConnectors](~~DescribeAckClusterConnectors~~): Lists ACK cluster connectors
parameters.help_zh:
ACK集群连接器ID。取值来源：
[DescribeAckClusterConnectors](~~DescribeAckClusterConnectors~~)：批量查询ACK集群连接器列表
parameters.name: connector_id

parameters.help_en: The language in which the health status error reason of the ACK cluster connector is displayed
parameters.help_zh: 显示ACK集群连接器健康状态错误原因的语言类型
parameters.name: lang

ClusterId.description_en:
The ID of the ACK cluster. You can obtain the value from:
[DescribeAckClusters](~~DescribeAckClusters~~): Lists ACK clusters
ClusterId.description_zh:
ACK集群ID。取值来源：
[DescribeAckClusters](~~DescribeAckClusters~~)：批量查询ACK集群列表

ClusterName.description_en: The name of the ACK cluster

ConnectorHealthCheckStatus.description_en: The health check status of the ACK cluster connector
ConnectorHealthCheckStatus.description_zh: ACK集群连接器的健康检查状态

ConnectorId.description_en:
The ID of the ACK cluster connector. You can obtain the value from:
[DescribeAckClusterConnectors](~~DescribeAckClusterConnectors~~): Lists ACK cluster connectors
ConnectorId.description_zh:
ACK集群连接器ID。取值来源：
[DescribeAckClusterConnectors](~~DescribeAckClusterConnectors~~)：批量查询ACK集群连接器列表

ConnectorName.description_en: The name of the ACK cluster connector. The name is 1 to 64 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
ConnectorName.description_zh: ACK集群连接器名称。长度为1~64个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）

ConnectorStatus.description_en: The instance status of the ACK cluster connector

CreateTime.description_en: The timestamp when the ACK cluster connector was created. Unit: seconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 创建ACK集群连接器的时间戳，单位：秒

MemberUid.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud UID of the account to which the ACK cluster resource belongs
MemberUid.description_zh: ACK集群资源所属的阿里云UID

PrimaryVswitchId.description_en:
The primary vSwitch of the ACK cluster connector. You can obtain the value from:
[DescribeAccessInstanceVSwitchList](~~DescribeAccessInstanceVSwitchList~~): Lists vSwitches of synchronization nodes
PrimaryVswitchId.description_zh:
ACK集群连接器主交换机。取值来源：
[DescribeAccessInstanceVSwitchList](~~DescribeAccessInstanceVSwitchList~~)：批量查询同步节点交换机列表

PrimaryVswitchIp.description_en: The IP address of the primary vSwitch of the ACK cluster connector

PrimaryVswitchZoneId.description_en:
The zone of the primary vSwitch of the ACK cluster connector. You can obtain the value from:
[DescribeAccessInstanceZoneList](~~DescribeAccessInstanceZoneList~~): Lists zones of synchronization node vSwitches
PrimaryVswitchZoneId.description_zh:
ACK集群连接器主交换机可用区。取值来源：
[DescribeAccessInstanceZoneList](~~DescribeAccessInstanceZoneList~~)：批量查询同步节点交换机可用区列表

RegionNo.description_en:
The region ID of the ACK cluster connector. You can obtain the value from:
[DescribeAccessInstanceRegionList](~~DescribeAccessInstanceRegionList~~): Queries the list of synchronization node regions.

For more information about the regions supported by ACK cluster connectors in Cloud Firewall, see [ACK cluster synchronization nodes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2865120.html）
RegionNo.description_zh:
ACK集群连接器地域ID。取值来源：
[DescribeAccessInstanceRegionList](~~DescribeAccessInstanceRegionList~~)：查询同步节点地域列表。

关于云防火墙支持ACK集群连接器地域的详细信息，请参见[ACK集群同步节点]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2865120.html）

StandbyVswitchId.description_en:
The standby vSwitch of the ACK cluster connector. You can obtain the value from:
[DescribeAccessInstanceVSwitchList](~~DescribeAccessInstanceVSwitchList~~): Lists vSwitches of synchronization nodes
StandbyVswitchId.description_zh:
ACK集群连接器备交换机。取值来源：
[DescribeAccessInstanceVSwitchList](~~DescribeAccessInstanceVSwitchList~~)：批量查询同步节点交换机列表

StandbyVswitchIp.description_en: The IP address of the standby vSwitch of the ACK cluster connector

StandbyVswitchZoneId.description_en:
The zone of the standby vSwitch of the ACK cluster connector. You can obtain the value from:
[DescribeAccessInstanceZoneList](~~DescribeAccessInstanceZoneList~~): Lists zones of synchronization node vSwitches
StandbyVswitchZoneId.description_zh:
ACK集群连接器备交换机可用区。取值来源：
[DescribeAccessInstanceZoneList](~~DescribeAccessInstanceZoneList~~)：批量查询同步节点交换机可用区列表

Ttl.description_en: The synchronization interval of the ACK cluster connector. Valid values: 2 to 60. Unit: seconds
Ttl.description_zh: ACK集群连接器同步周期间隔。范围：2~60秒

UnhealthyReason.description_en: The reason why the ACK cluster connector is unhealthy
UnhealthyReason.description_zh: ACK集群连接器不健康的原因
UnhealthyReason.example: The ACK cluster status is unavailable.

VpcId.description_en: The instance ID of the VPC-connected instance to which the ACK cluster belongs
